orders.instructions: Antipsychotic: review every 3 months. Next review 2 Nov. Record behaviour chart.
Time-critical: give within 30 minutes of the due time. Do not stop suddenly.
Thicken to level 2 before giving. Upright 90 degrees.
Remove old patch. New site daily, do not reuse a site for 14 days.

vitals.note: Wet cough after breakfast. Chest sounds clear on the left, coarse on the right.

alerts.title: Aggression or behaviour reported: Boon Huat
alerts.detail: No harm. Pushed a care aide during his shower at 07:40 and shouted at other residents. Settled with one-to-one in the garden.

alerts.title: Risperidone refused 3 times this week
alerts.detail: 20:00 dose refused on 19, 21 and 23 Oct. More distressed in the evenings. Tell Dr Lim before the review on 2 Nov.

alerts.title: NEWS2 4: watch
alerts.detail: RR 22, SpO₂ 94%, temp 37.8 °C. Wet cough after breakfast. Possible aspiration: repeat obs in 4 hours, sit upright for meals.

alerts.title: Heel dressing due today
alerts.detail: Left heel pressure injury, category 2. Foam dressing change due.

tasks.text: Change left heel dressing and measure wound

notes.text: Shower at 07:40: became upset when the water was turned on, pushed me away with both hands and shouted. No one hurt. Stopped the shower and stepped back. Joseph took him to the garden and he settled after 15 minutes.
Coughing during breakfast, wet voice after. Stopped feeding, sat fully upright. RR 22, SpO₂ 94%. Speech therapist referral for swallow review. Son informed.
Refused risperidone at 20:00 again, pushed the cup away. Walked the corridor until 22:30, settled with music and a warm drink.
Saw 'children in the room' this morning, not distressed. Hallucinations as usual for him. No change in obs.

problems.title: Aggression during personal care
interventions: Explain each step, one at a time
Offer a wash at the sink if he says no
Walk away and return in 10 minutes

problems.title: High risk of pressure injury
interventions: Check skin at each pad change

problems.title: Risk of aspiration
interventions: Upright 90 degrees for meals and 30 minutes after
Small spoonfuls, check mouth is clear

problems.title: High risk of falls
problems.basis: Morse 75 after the fall on 19 Oct

incidents.what: Became upset when the shower was turned on, pushed the care aide with both hands and shouted at residents in the corridor.
incidents.action: Stopped the shower and stepped back. Taken to the garden one-to-one, settled after 15 minutes. Wash at the sink offered later.

incidents.what: Seen by the nurse losing his balance when turning with his frame at 21:00. Sat down on the floor, did not hit his head.
incidents.action: Checked for injury, helped up with two staff using the hoist. Obs normal.

review.findings: Turned quickly at the end of the corridor. Tamsulosin at 22:00 and a lying-standing drop.
review.actions: Night light and bed alarm. Ask Dr Lim about moving tamsulosin to the morning.

incidents.what: Froze while turning from the table and fell sideways onto his left hip. Witnessed.
incidents.injury: Bruise on left hip, walking normally
incidents.action: Checked for injury, X-ray not needed per Dr Lim. Ice pack.

review.findings: Freezing on turning, worse before the 12:00 dose.
review.actions: Physio for turning strategy. Lunch seat facing the corridor.

closed.summary: Bruise only. Physio cueing strategy in place.

incidents.what: Skin tear on the right forearm found after she was helped into bed.

review.findings: Long sleeves caught on the bed rail.
review.actions: Padded rail covers. Short sleeves at bedtime.

handovers.summary: Restless night for Koh Ah Lian, walking 02:00 to 03:30. Tay Geok Hoon refused risperidone again. Ng Siew Eng coughing after drinks, watch.

audit.detail: Fall, no harm. Lost balance turning with his frame, witnessed. Post-fall observations scheduled.
Factors: Walking aid not in reach, Low blood pressure. Turned quickly at the end of the corridor.
